name: Should I update appliances during a rental turnover renovation?

mainEntity.name: Should I update appliances during a rental turnover renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Updating appliances during a rental turnover renovation can significantly enhance a property's appeal and potentially command higher rent. Modern, energy-efficient appliances are a strong selling point for prospective tenants and can also reduce utility costs in the long run. If existing appliances are old, inefficient, or mismatched, replacing them can provide a noticeable upgrade. Consider the overall market expectations for rentals in your area.
acceptedAnswer.description: Updating appliances can boost appeal, attract higher rent, and offer energy efficiency. Replace old, inefficient, or mismatched units.
